class: A child process inherits a parent's stale copy of settings the owner has since changed
symptom: A setting changed in .env (on Settings or by hand) was not used by the next application until the dashboard was restarted; the owner had to be told to restart after every change.
root_cause: The dashboard read .env once, at start, into its environment; every run was started with that environment, and the run's own load_dotenv() does not override variables it already has.
why_tests_missed: Tests set configuration directly; none started a run after changing .env.
fix: web_ui.run_environment() starts each run with the server's environment and .env, as it is now, on top.
prevention: A long-running parent that starts workers passes them the current settings, read at the moment it starts each one, not the copy it read when it began.
